events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic 'Abbey Road' album, originally released on September 26, 1969, is remembered today.

angles.name: Abbey Road Legacy
angles.copy: That iconic zebra crossing. That incredible tracklist. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' album is being remembered today – what's your favourite moment from this masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Tribute
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her powerful voice and songwriting with The Pretenders continue to inspire. What's your top Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday Bash
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: Imagine (UK Single) Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem "Imagine" was first released as a single in the UK in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: On this day, we're remembering John Lennon's 'Imagine' – first released as a UK single in '75. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of Apple's introduction of the groundbreaking first-generation iPod, which originally launched on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: Remembering the iPod
angles.copy: Before streaming, there was the iPod. We're looking back at the device that changed how we listened to music forever. Did you have one of the originals?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the release of the first 007 film, *Dr. No*, in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the iconic theme tunes to the unforgettable gadgets, what's your all-time favourite 007 moment or song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the life and enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is truly timeless. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album' and originally released on November 22, 1968, is remembered today.

angles.name: White Album Revisited
angles.copy: An album that broke new ground and showcased The Beatles' diverse talents. We're looking back at 'The White Album' today. What are your standout tracks?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Freddie's Timeless Talent
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today. His incredible voice and electrifying stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Impact
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since its release, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' remains a pivotal album. It marked a creative shift that reshaped pop music. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the tragic death of John Lennon, who would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Peace
angles.copy: On the anniversary of his passing, we reflect on the profound musical and peace legacy of John Lennon. His message continues to resonate worldwide.
